text:
maria: Quick sync — mapping tenant-slice opportunities into a prioritization + acceptance criteria doc. Goal: pick top 3 slices for Q3 pilot. Need input on cost delta, SLOs, and rollback story.
aj: +1 — we should focus on the ones that unblock Dedicated customers first.
kiran: Can you share the matrix you want to use? cost vs latency vs operational complexity?
maria: Yeah — I'm thinking columns: customer impact (revenue/strategic), delta cost (est monthly), p95/p99 latency impact, isolation mode needed (soft/soft+cache/hard), migration effort, required policy changes.
devin: I sketched rough thresholds: p99 increase <= 20ms ok for soft ; >20ms requires hard isolation or model variant.
rebecca: Sales note: two customers asked for data residency+hard isolation — high revenue. They'd pay for reserved capacity but want rollout guarantees.
maria: Good. Let's capture acceptance criteria per slice. Example: ""Slice: EU-regulated-enterprise"" -> acceptance: hard isolation available; KMS integration validated; p99 < 200ms for baseline requests; fallback to regional spare capacity; SLA in contract.
aj: For the matrix, add an "automation/ops burden" column — manual runbooks spike cost.
kiran: I'll add a column for required routing changes: new policy templates? route-by-tenant vs route-by-region.
devin: Ops constraints: we can add prefix KV caching to reduce tail latency for many customers without hard isolation. That might keep cost down for medium-impact tenants.
maria: Team asks: who can estimate delta cost for 3 slices by EOD Friday? And who will own acceptance criteria doc?
rebecca: I can consolidate customer asks and revenue impact.
aj: I'll run a quick perf sim on current model variants and get latency delta estimates.
kiran: I'll list routing policy changes and risk level (low/med/high).
devin: I'll write rollback and fallback playbook draft.
maria: For prioritization, propose scoring: weighted sum (customer impact 40%, cost delta 25%, ops burden 20%, latency risk 15%). Anyone object?
rebecca: Fine by me. Suggest we bump latency to 25% for latency-sensitive customers.
aj: OK to test both weightings — we can present two ranked lists to leadership.
maria: Action items: 1) Rebecca — customer mapping + revenue impact (owner: rebecca) 2) AJ — perf deltas per model variant (owner: aj) 3) Kiran — routing policy diff + template changes (owner: kiran) 4) Devin — rollback/fallback playbook + estimated ops hours (owner: devin) 5) Maria — glue into prioritization doc and schedule review on Monday.
rebecca: ETA Friday EOD for customer mapping.
aj: Perf sim results by Friday as well — I'll include p95/p99 and token cost delta.
kiran: Routing diff by Thursday.
devin: Playbook draft by Friday.
maria: Quick checklist for acceptance criteria examples (feel free to copy into doc):
- Isolation mode defined (soft/soft+cache/hard)
- Model variant fallback defined (list of compatible variants)
- p95/p99 SLOs specified in ms
- Cost delta (monthly $) with conservative and optimistic estimates
- Rollback trigger conditions and simple runbook (commands to force fallback)
- Test prompts and eval set to detect quality regressions
- Telemetry hooks (token counts, latency histograms, error rates)
- Compliance gating (KMS, audit logs, region-only routing)
maria: Example: ""EU-enterprise slice acceptance"": [isolation=hard, fallback=regional-lite-variant, p99<=200ms, cost_delta=+$4.5k/mo, rollback=auto-fallback + pager].
aj: Small nit: ensure fallback variants are performance-profiled for same prompts — otherwise regressions will be invisible. Add eval step.
rebecca: I'll annotate by-customer which accept higher latency vs require hard isolation.
kiran: Risk note: route-by-tenant requires policy engine changes; estimate 3 sprint tickets vs route-by-region which is much simpler but coarser.
devin: Ops note: we should standardize a /runbook endpoint to trigger fallback for a tenant; reduces manual toil.
maria: This is helpful. If everyone hits their ETAs we'll have a prioritized pilot list and full acceptance criteria Monday review.
salesbot: Reminder: customer "FinLedger" has contract renewal in 6 weeks; flagging as high priority. :bell:
rebecca: noted — FinLedger wants residency + audit logs. I'll surface pricing flexibility.
aj: One more technical concern: burst capacity sizing. For hard isolation we need reserved GPU headroom. I'll include rough memory/GPU needs per slice.
maria: We'll capture that in the cost_delta estimate.
kiran: Proposal: pilot 1 = 1 hard-isolation EU tenant (FinLedger), pilot 2 = 2 soft slices across regions, pilot 3 = experimentation with prefix caching for small tenants. Anyone object?
devin: Sounds pragmatic. Gives us immediate revenue path + ops learning.
rebecca: Agreed.
aj: Agree.
maria: Ok — owners please update the doc in the product drive: /product/roadmap/tenant-slice-opportunity-mapping.md and drop link here when done. Meeting Monday 10am to decide final pilots.
rebecca: Link added: https://rwd.in/drive/tenant-slice-opportunities (draft).
kiran: Uploaded routing impact sheet.
aj: Perf sim results posted to the doc.
devin: Playbook draft uploaded.
maria: Thanks all — see you Monday. :thumbsup:
